artboards.title: Today — the composer as it renders

annotations.text:
“I think the answered circle border radius is too round.” — issue #705, /prayer, 1107×662, dark.

The element is the “How was it answered?” compose box. It is not a taste call: the input asks for a 32px radius inside a 62px-tall box, so CSS clamps it to 31px — exactly half the height — and it renders as a lozenge.

Crimson = what renders today. Green = what is proposed.

32 / 32 / 24 / 16  →  10 / 10 / 10 / 14

SHIPPED — f5035ee.

Five values change, all inside the compose box. Nothing moves, nothing resizes, no copy changes, and Skip / Save stay pills.

The nest descends for the first time: card 24 → panel 14 → controls 10.

These boards draw the desktop composer, but the same box exists seven times across three files — testimony and archive-reason, on desktop, mobile and the landing rows. All seven moved together; splitting them would leave one feature wearing two shapes.

Left alone, deliberately — and verified untouched in the shipped diff.

· The same rounded-xl → 32px lands on 283 call sites, including the answered-testimony display box and the edit textarea in this very row. Re-basing them is a separate decision and a separate diff.

· --radius-md, --radius-2xl and --radius-3xl are never re-valued, so the utility ladder is non-monotonic in three places. Naming them on @theme would fix the class of bug rather than this instance — worth an ADR, not this change.

· --radius-pill: 999px is defined and has zero uses; all 580 pills are rounded-full.
